description: Notable quotes from Eastern and Western ancient texts. Used by the Sacred Library and by the Oracle to cite authorities when generating answers.

quotes.author: Lao Tzu
quotes.text: The highest good is like water. Water benefits the ten thousand things but does not compete. It dwells in places people dislike, thus it is close to the Way.

quotes.author: Lao Tzu
quotes.text: Knowing others is intelligence; knowing yourself is true wisdom. Mastering others is strength; mastering yourself is true power.

quotes.author: Lao Tzu
quotes.text: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.

quotes.author: Lao Tzu
quotes.text: When I let go of what I am, I become what I might be.

quotes.author: Lao Tzu
quotes.text: Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished.

quotes.author: Zhuangzi
quotes.text: When the mind is still, the whole world can be at peace. Clarity of mind allows the reflection of the natural order.

quotes.author: Zhuangzi
quotes.text: Happiness is the absence of the striving for happiness.

quotes.author: Zhuangzi
quotes.text: Flow with whatever may happen and let your mind be free. Stay centered by accepting whatever you are doing. This is the ultimate.

quotes.author: Zhuangzi
quotes.text: The wise man knows that it is better to sit by the river than to cross it when the time is not right.

quotes.author: Confucius
quotes.text: When we see men of worth, we should think of equaling them; when we see men of a contrary character, we should turn inwards and examine ourselves.

quotes.author: Confucius
quotes.text: It does not matter how slowly you go so long as you do not stop.

quotes.author: Confucius
quotes.text: Wherever you go, go with all your heart.

quotes.author: Confucius
quotes.text: The noble-minded are calm and steady; the small-minded are always fretful and anxious.

quotes.author: Confucius
quotes.text: Real knowledge is to know the extent of one's ignorance.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.text: All experience is preceded by mind, led by mind, made by mind. Speak or act with a peaceful mind, and happiness follows.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.text: We are what we think. All that we are arises with our thoughts. With our thoughts we make the world.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.text: The mind is everything. What you think you become.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.text: Holding on to anger is like grasping a hot coal with the intent of throwing it at someone else; you are the one who gets burned.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.text: Peace comes from within. Do not seek it without.

quotes.author: Heart Sutra
quotes.text: Form is emptiness, emptiness is form. Beyond suffering and cause of suffering, beyond wisdom and attainment.

quotes.author: I Ching
quotes.text: The superior person remains composed and at peace; in change they find their opportunity.

quotes.author: I Ching
quotes.text: Perseverance furthers. When the time is right, advance; when it is not, wait in correctness.

quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius
quotes.text: You have power over your mind — not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.

quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius
quotes.text: The happiness of your life depends upon the quality of your thoughts.

quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius
quotes.text: Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.

quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius
quotes.text: When you arise in the morning, think of what a precious privilege it is to be alive — to breathe, to think, to enjoy, to love.

quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius
quotes.text: Accept the things to which fate binds you, and love the people with whom fate brings you together, and do so with all your heart.

quotes.author: Seneca
quotes.text: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality. The present moment is all we truly have.

quotes.author: Seneca
quotes.text: It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it. Life is long enough if you know how to use it.

quotes.author: Seneca
quotes.text: Luck is what happens when preparation meets opportunity.

quotes.author: Seneca
quotes.text: We are more often frightened than hurt; and we suffer more from imagination than from reality.

quotes.author: Seneca
quotes.text: As is a tale, so is life: not how long it is, but how good it is, is what matters.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.text: It is not things that disturb people, but their judgments about things.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.text: Make the best use of what is in your power, and take the rest as it happens.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.text: First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.text: We cannot choose our external circumstances, but we can always choose how we respond to them.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.text: Only the educated are free.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.text: No man ever steps in the same river twice, for it's not the same river and he's not the same man.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.text: The only constant in life is change.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.text: Character is destiny.

quotes.author: Plato
quotes.text: The first and greatest victory is to conquer yourself.

quotes.author: Plato
quotes.text: The unexamined life is not worth living.

quotes.author: Plato
quotes.text: The soul takes nothing with her to the next world but her education and culture; and these, we are told, are of the greatest service or the greatest harm to the dead person.

quotes.author: Aristotle
quotes.text: Excellence is never an accident. It is always the result of high intention, sincere effort, and intelligent execution.

quotes.author: Aristotle
quotes.text: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act but a habit.

quotes.author: Aristotle
quotes.text: Knowing yourself is the beginning of all wisdom.

quotes.author: Rumi
quotes.text: The wound is the place where the light enters you.

quotes.author: Rumi
quotes.text: What you seek is seeking you.

quotes.author: Rumi
quotes.text: Let yourself be silently drawn by the strange pull of what you really love. It will not lead you astray.

quotes.author: Rumi
quotes.text: Yesterday I was clever, so I wanted to change the world. Today I am wise, so I am changing myself.

quotes.author: Bhagavad Gita
quotes.text: You have the right to work, but never to the fruit of work. Let not the fruits of action be your motive, nor let your attachment be to inaction.

quotes.author: Bhagavad Gita
quotes.text: The soul is neither born, nor does it ever die; nor having once been, does it ever cease to be. It is unborn, eternal, ever-existing, and primeval.

quotes.author: Bhagavad Gita
quotes.text: When the mind is restless and distracted, bring it back to the Self and master it.
